svg.title: TabPFN v3 - classifier
svg.desc: Prior-Labs - three stages: per column, per row, in context · 53.2 M parameters. Symbols in shapes: B: ensemble members (batch); n: rows in the context (train + test); p: raw features; F: feature groups; E: embedding width; n_test: test rows (the rows being predicted). Abbreviations: ICL: in-context learning: test rows attend to the labelled training rows; CLS: learned summary token that reads out a row or column; RoPE: rotary position embedding; MLP: multilayer perceptron (the feed-forward sublayer); GELU: Gaussian error linear unit (activation); RMSNorm: root-mean-square normalisation; KV: keys and values (as in KV cache, KV heads); NaN: not-a-number: undefined values in the input; NA: missing values in the input. How to read: × N: the block is stacked N times; its sublayers are drawn once; over rows / columns / features: the axis this block's attention runs across; card colour: what kind of stage it is (see the legend above); right margin: the tensor shape each stage emits, then its exact parameter count; left margin: the phase each group of stages belongs to.
